# how-to-web Dialog

> Reconstruction guidance for the how-to-web modal Dialog organism.

Use [Build DNA](./build-dna.json) as the normative contract. The examples demonstrate different focus strategies; they are not separate specifications.

## Primary

- [Build DNA](./build-dna.json)
- [Dialog reference](./index.md)
- [Research](./RESEARCH.md)
- [Human reference](./)

## Variants

- [Information data](./examples/information.json)
- [Information example](./examples/information.html)
- [Form data](./examples/form.json)
- [Form example](./examples/form.html)
- [Confirmation data](./examples/confirmation.json)
- [Confirmation example](./examples/confirmation.html)

## Agent instruction

Preserve modal semantics, accessible naming, initial-focus strategy, background inertness, Escape, explicit dismissal and focus return. Prefer native dialog behavior when available. Do not invent backdrop-close, destructive defaults or workflow side effects.
